SectionEditor(master[, apply_callback, app_ref])

A ttk.Frame containing a Treeview for editing section labels and colors via a pop-up dialog, and an 'Update Sections' button.
class section_editor.SectionEditor(master, apply_callback=None, app_ref=None, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: Frame

A ttk.Frame containing a Treeview for editing section labels and colors via a pop-up dialog, and an ‘Update Sections’ button. Includes color indicator column.

__init__(master, apply_callback=None, app_ref=None, **kwargs)[source]

Initialize the SectionEditor frame.

Parameters:

  • master – The parent widget (likely the editor_outer_frame).

  • apply_callback (callable) – A function to call when the ‘Update’ button is pressed.

  • app_ref (AudioAnalyzerApp) – Reference to the main application instance.

  • **kwargs – Additional keyword arguments for the ttk.Frame.

populate(track_data)[source]

Fills the Treeview editor with current section data and applies row color tags.

clear()[source]

Clears the Treeview and disables the update button.
